# Improved Plan

The Awtsmoos joins precision and mercy in one progressing line;
Awtsmoos.com keeps each production gate observable by design.

## Phase A — shared truth

1. Add versioned affinity, element, status, and typed-action records under `shared/combat/`.
2. Add schema validation in one small client ESM adapter and one small server CommonJS adapter.
3. Add pure contextual effectiveness resolution with ordered diagnostics.
4. Add pure Daas insight filtering and bounded status-instance rules.

## Phase B — player authority

5. Enrich existing Torah abilities and melee actions with canonical action IDs and affinity metadata.
6. Extend player profile defaults and migration with affinity allocation, Daas, Gevurah, and defense compatibility.
7. Connect client prediction to the shared resolver without claiming authoritative damage.
8. Connect server attack validation and damage receipts to shared actions and effectiveness diagnostics.
9. Add cast-instance interruption state, pre-launch validation, and bounded replay protection.

## Phase C — enemy authority

10. Add enemy affinity profiles, resistance profiles, interrupt profiles, and typed action decks.
11. Extend enemy action runtime receipts with cast identity, affinity, telegraph, and interruption fields.
12. Apply affinity phases to the Kedem Warden through its existing phase machinery.
13. Filter enemy cast insight by server-permitted Daas tier.

## Phase D — presentation

14. Add cast HUD models with text, icon, shape, motion, Hebrew name, translation, danger, target, and counter guidance.
15. Add quality-scaled effect families and reduced-motion fallbacks without blocking readiness.
16. Add player loadout presentation and status indicators through existing UI stores.

## Phase E — environment and persistence

17. Add bounded environmental reaction tags and cleanup.
18. Migrate existing saves safely and preserve exact-once rewards.
19. Prove local authority and multiplayer authority use identical IDs and equivalent rules.

## Phase F — verification

20. Add focused tests after production wiring.
21. Run client and server matrices.
22. Build compactJs twice and compare manifests.
23. Build canonical CSS twice and compare manifests.
24. Run isolated performance profiling.
25. Run desktop, mobile, landscape, reduced-motion, high-contrast, offline, reconnect, WebGL-failure, and Canvas2D browser acceptance.
26. Audit syntax, imports, tabs, whitespace, line counts, processes, and worktree state.
